data.long_description:
Golf Grand at Dubai Hills Estate sets a new standard in luxury living. Experience the thrill of residing in this premier development, where sophistication meets opulence, and enjoy breathtaking views of an 18-hole championship golf course.

Imagine a place with stunning natural beauty and a green championship golf course that goes on forever. Just for a moment, picture yourself with every desire satisfied. Imagine what it would be like to have everything your heart could ever want in a community of like-minded people. This is the place where you can watch your family grow and create lasting memories together in a luxury home tailored to your needs.

This distinctly green and family-friendly neighbourhood has charmed residents and visitors alike with its quiet, unpretentious character and easy living amongst the many stores and conveniences nearby. This is your quiet urban piece of Dubai.
